units.source_text: 公共汽车驶出伊东市，在海滨路上，遇上了一群背着柴火的妇女，她们手里拿着贯众草。

en.t: The bus drove out of Ito City and, on the seaside road, came upon a group of women carrying firewood on their backs, holding fern fronds in their hands.

units.source_text: 有的妇女用贯众草把柴火捆绑起来。

en.t: Some of the women had tied their firewood together with the fern fronds.

units.source_text: 我突然觉得人是可亲的，心情就像越过高山看见了缭绕上升的炊烟一样。

en.t: Suddenly I felt that people were dear and approachable, and my heart was as if, after crossing high mountains, I had seen cooking smoke curling upward.

units.source_text: 可以说这些寻常准备过年的生活习惯，令我十分怀念。

en.t: One could say that these ordinary customs of preparing for the New Year filled me with deep nostalgia.

units.source_text: 我恍如从异常的世界逃脱了出来。

en.t: It was as though I had escaped from an abnormal world.

units.source_text: 妇女们大概是拾柴火回家烧饭吧。

en.t: The women had probably gathered firewood and were going home to cook a meal.

units.source_text: 海呈现出一派冬日的景色。

en.t: The sea had taken on a thoroughly wintry aspect.

units.source_text: 太阳显得暗淡无光，突然昏沉下来。

en.t: The sun looked dim and lusterless, then suddenly sank into a murky gloom.
